title: MacroPPI-Bench: data and code for "Generative AI for Macrocyclic Peptides at Cancer and Other Protein Interfaces: Two Refuted Assumptions"

creators.name: Thakar, Sambhaji Balaso
creators.affiliation: Advanced Data Science and Gen AI Unit, Aditya BioNova Analytics, Pune, Maharashtra, India

creators.name: Ghorpade, Pradnya Namdev
creators.affiliation: Advanced Data Science and Gen AI Unit, Aditya BioNova Analytics, Pune, Maharashtra, India

description: Curated benchmark, analysis code and generated results for the study Generative AI for Macrocyclic Peptides at Cancer and Other Protein Interfaces: Two Refuted Assumptions. Contains MacroPPI-Bench Tier 1 (65 synthesised macrocyclic peptide designs, 24 binders, 6 protein targets, with per-row provenance); a per-design table joining all 77 designs of the RFpeptides campaign to their published in-silico filter scores, synthesis status and binding outcome; the closure-share gradient diagnostic and its pre-registered decision rule applied to head-to-tail, disulfide and bicycle topologies; and the within-target retrospective evaluation of the four published selection filters. Pure Python 3 with NumPy and Matplotlib; no GPU, licensed software or force-field package required. All stochastic steps are seeded and reruns reproduce the deposited outputs exactly.
